resampling.bootstrap: Uniform N document rows sampled with replacement within each corpus/group; recompute top-decile share, zero-P share, both ratios and prose/all-kind densities. Raw unique-document counts are not the resampling denominator.
resampling.intervals: 2.5% and 97.5% nearest-rank endpoints among defined draws; record defined and undefined counts. Null central ranges are reference bands, bootstrap ranges are descriptive intervals, not population confidence guarantees.
resampling.length_null: Exact multivariate hypergeometric marginals over per-document eligible statement slots, preserving observed total P and per-document slot capacities. Uniform distinct-slot allocation without replacement.
resampling.null_p: (1 + null draws >= observed)/(499+1), descriptive upper-tail reference only; no multiplicity-adjusted or causal hypothesis claim.
resampling.rng_revision: Existing NumPy 2.4.6 PCG64 Generator, SHA-256(seed|purpose|corpus|group|arm|segmentation|triggers) seed integer. Same sampling laws as legacy; not bit-identical legacy random.Random draws.
resampling.serial: 499 sequential draws in each frozen key, not data-adaptive draws. Overlap rules share P null and bootstrap document draws.
